decisions.original: .page-hero.showroom-catalog-hero { padding: calc(var(--header-height) + 2.5rem) 0 2.5rem; }
decisions.proposed: Make the Collections hero approximately 220–260px tall on desktop and adjust responsive sizing. Preserve filtering, search, counts, and catalog behavior.

decisions.original: #catalog { scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--header-height) + 1rem); }
decisions.proposed: When a homepage category link opens a filtered Collections view, position the catalog about one-quarter viewport lower than it currently lands, while keeping the sticky header clear. Preserve filtering and the grid/sidebar.

decisions.original: Designed for weddings, anniversaries, housewarmings, and family heritage gifts, each indoor plaque is personalized with a family name and two, three, or four country flags. The design is laser engraved in solid cherry wood before the flags are painted and the piece is finished by hand in the Kennedy Laser Works workshop.
decisions.proposed: Celebrate the places that helped make your family yours. This cherry wood plaque brings a family name together with two to four hand-painted country flags and an optional established year, making it a meaningful wedding, anniversary, or housewarming gift.

decisions.original: A round St. Patrick’s Day sign with raised ‘Happy St. Paddy’s Day’ lettering and shamrock accents. Its green, white, and wood-toned design appears both on its own and among holiday decorations in the gallery.
decisions.proposed: Welcome St. Patrick’s Day with a cheerful greeting at your entryway. This shamrock door hanger brings a bit of Irish spirit to seasonal decorating and makes a fun gift for someone who loves the holiday.
decisions.customText: Add a little Irish charm to your home this St. Patrick's Day! This handcrafted shamrock door hanger features a cheerful "Happy St. Paddy's Day" greeting and makes a festive addition to your front door, entryway, or seasonal decorations.
decisions.polishedText: Add a little Irish charm to your home this St. Patrick’s Day! This handcrafted shamrock door hanger features a cheerful “Happy St. Paddy’s Day” greeting and makes a festive addition to your front door, entryway, or seasonal decorations.

decisions.original: A green shamrock wall hanging with ‘Sláinte’ across the center and smaller decorative lettering beneath it. The gallery shows the layered face, edge, and reverse so you can see how it looks beyond the styled holiday photo.
decisions.proposed: Raise a toast to Irish heritage with a Sláinte wall hanging. Sláinte means “health,” so this piece brings a warm wish to your St. Patrick’s Day decorating or a gift for a friend who would appreciate it.
decisions.customText: Bring a little Irish cheer into your home with this handcrafted Sláinte shamrock wall hanging! “Sláinte” is a traditional Irish toast meaning “health,” making this a festive decoration for St. Patrick's Day or a fun gift for anyone proud of their Irish heritage.
decisions.polishedText: Bring a little Irish cheer into your home with this handcrafted Sláinte shamrock wall hanging! “Sláinte” is a traditional Irish toast meaning “health,” making this a festive decoration for St. Patrick’s Day or a fun gift for anyone proud of their Irish heritage.

decisions.original: This leprechaun-themed St. Patrick’s Day sign pairs ‘Kiss Me I’m Irish’ lettering with a green hat and shamrock details. Front and side photographs show the character-shaped outline and raised design.
decisions.proposed: Let your St. Patrick’s Day decorations show their sense of humor. The “Kiss Me I’m Irish” sign is a playful way to celebrate the holiday and share a laugh with guests.

decisions.original: A round clover-themed hanger with ‘Happy St. Patrick’s Day’ lettering framed by green shamrocks. The photographs include a seasonal display, the face of the sign, and its reverse.
decisions.proposed: Set the mood for St. Patrick’s Day before guests even step inside. This clover-themed hanger adds a festive greeting to an entryway or holiday display.

decisions.original: A green shamrock sign reading ‘Let the Shenanigans Begin’ in contrasting lettering. Photographs of the front and back make this a straightforward choice for playful St. Patrick’s Day decor.
decisions.proposed: Start the St. Patrick’s Day shenanigans before the party does. This playful shamrock sign feels right at home in a festive gathering or beside the rest of your Irish holiday decorations.

decisions.original: Two separate green shamrock accents designed to frame the upper corners of a door. The gallery shows the pair together and individually, including their layered clover shapes.
decisions.proposed: Frame an indoor doorway with a little Irish luck. These two shamrock corner accents give St. Patrick’s Day decorating a fresh spot beyond the usual wall sign.

decisions.original: A wooden bunny holds a ‘Welcome’ plaque in this spring sign, with layered ears and floral details. The gallery shows the full front, an angled view, and the reverse with its hanging point.
decisions.proposed: Give family and friends a sweet spring welcome. This Easter bunny sign adds a friendly greeting to an entryway or seasonal display without needing a special occasion beyond the holiday itself.

decisions.original: A round Easter door hanger with a bunny silhouette, pastel lettering, and spring flower details. Front and angled views show the layered design, while the reverse appears in the gallery as well.
decisions.proposed: Let the Easter bunny greet everyone who visits. This door hanger makes a cheerful addition to spring decorations and a fun gift for someone who loves celebrating Easter.
decisions.customText: Hop into spring with a little Easter cheer! Welcome family and friends with this handcrafted Easter Bunny Door Hanger, a festive way to brighten your entryway and celebrate the season. It also makes a sweet Easter gift for someone special.
decisions.polishedText: Hop into spring with a little Easter cheer! Welcome family and friends with this handcrafted Easter Bunny Door Hanger, a festive way to brighten your entryway and celebrate the season. It also makes a sweet Easter gift for someone special.

decisions.original: Carrots and bunny ears frame the ‘Every Bunny Welcome’ message on this round Easter sign. The photos show its colorful front, layered edge, and reverse for a clearer look at the finished piece.
decisions.proposed: “Every Bunny Welcome” says exactly what this Easter sign is for. Bring it into an entryway or family space where its playful message can welcome the season.
decisions.customText: Every bunny is welcome! Bring some Easter cheer to your home with this playful, handcrafted welcome sign. Featuring an adorable bunny-and-carrot theme, it's a fun way to greet family and friends and brighten up your spring decorations.
decisions.polishedText: Every bunny is welcome! Bring some Easter cheer to your home with this playful, handcrafted welcome sign. Featuring an adorable bunny-and-carrot theme, it’s a fun way to greet family and friends and brighten up your spring decorations.

decisions.original: The words ‘He Is Risen’ sit among white doves and leafy branches on this Easter sign. Its Christian message and layered wood design are shown from the front, side, and back.
decisions.proposed: Keep the message of Easter at the center of your seasonal decorating. This “He Is Risen” sign offers a meaningful way to celebrate the holiday at home or to give a faith-centered gift.
decisions.customText: Celebrate the true meaning of Easter with this handcrafted “He Is Risen” sign. A beautiful reminder of the hope and joy of Christ's resurrection, it's a meaningful addition to your Easter decorations or a thoughtful gift for someone who shares your faith.
decisions.polishedText: Celebrate the true meaning of Easter with this handcrafted “He Is Risen” sign. It’s a beautiful reminder of the hope and joy of Christ’s resurrection, a meaningful addition to your Easter decorations, or a thoughtful gift for someone who shares your faith.

decisions.original: A round spring welcome sign with tall bunny ears and paw-print details around the lettering. The front, angled side, and reverse are pictured so shoppers can see the shape and layering.
decisions.proposed: Welcome spring with a bunny sign that can stay up beyond Easter morning. Its friendly greeting suits an entryway, a family room, or a springtime gift.
decisions.customText: Welcome spring with a little bunny charm! This handcrafted Spring Bunny Door Hanger brings a cheerful touch to your front door or entryway. Perfect for celebrating the arrival of warmer weather, it's a decoration you can enjoy throughout the spring season, not just Easter.
decisions.polishedText: Welcome spring with a little bunny charm! This handcrafted Spring Bunny Door Hanger brings a cheerful touch to your front door or entryway. Perfect for celebrating the arrival of warmer weather, it’s a decoration you can enjoy throughout the spring season, not just Easter.

decisions.original: Bright ‘Hip Hop’ lettering and carrot accents give this Easter sign a playful look. Photos include the full front, an angled view of the layers, and the back.
decisions.proposed: Let the Easter decorations have a little fun. The bright “Hip Hop” message makes this sign a playful choice for a family celebration or a gift for someone who loves the season.
decisions.customText: Hop into Easter with a little fun! This playful “Hip Hop” Easter sign brings a cheerful touch to your spring decorating. Perfect for adding some personality to your home or giving as a fun Easter gift to someone who loves the holiday.
decisions.polishedText: Hop into Easter with a little fun! This playful “Hip Hop” Easter sign brings a cheerful touch to your spring decorating. It’s perfect for adding some personality to your home or giving as a fun Easter gift to someone who loves the holiday.

decisions.original: A spring sign featuring a chick, flowers, and a small ‘hi’ greeting. The gallery includes styled, front, side, and reverse views of the layered design.
decisions.proposed: That little “hi” is enough to make a spring display feel cheerful. This Easter chick sign brings a lighthearted welcome to a room or a gift for someone who enjoys seasonal decor.
decisions.customText: A little chick with a big hello! Welcome spring with this adorable handcrafted Easter Chick Sign. Its cheerful personality makes it a sweet addition to your seasonal decorations and a fun way to brighten your home for Easter and beyond.
decisions.polishedText: A little chick with a big hello! Welcome spring with this adorable handcrafted Easter Chick Sign. Its cheerful personality makes it a sweet addition to your seasonal decorations and a fun way to brighten your home for Easter and beyond.

decisions.original: A wooden rose with a name worked into the design, shown in several painted colors and close-up views. The gallery illustrates different finished examples without implying that every pictured color or lettering choice is currently available; check the Etsy listing for choices.
decisions.proposed: Flowers are lovely, but a rose with their name on it feels especially personal. This laser-cut wooden rose makes a sweet gift for Valentine’s Day, a birthday, or just because. Check Etsy for the name and color choices currently offered.

decisions.original: A wooden rose rises above a heart-shaped base with personalized lettering. The front and detail photos show how the flower and standing heart form one keepsake display.
decisions.proposed: Put a heartfelt message where someone can see it every day. This personalized rose-and-heart stand makes a small, meaningful gift for Valentine’s Day, an anniversary, or anyone you want to remind that they are loved.

decisions.original: A bouquet of wooden roses arranged in a vase, with heart accents that can carry personalized wording. The gallery shows the assembled display from several angles and includes close views of the flowers and hearts.
decisions.proposed: Give roses with a message that can stay on display. This wooden bouquet and vase pairs roses with hearts that can carry personalized wording, making it a thoughtful Valentine’s Day or anniversary gift. Confirm the wording choices currently offered on Etsy.

decisions.original: A wooden flower bouquet displayed in a vase, shown with several floral shapes and colors across the gallery. Photos of completed examples help illustrate the arrangement; consult Etsy for the personalization choices currently offered.
decisions.proposed: Brighten someone’s day with flowers made to stay on display beyond the occasion. This personalized wooden bouquet is a cheerful birthday, Mother’s Day, or just-because gift. See Etsy for the design and personalization choices currently offered.

decisions.original: A sunflower-shaped tribute to Mom with layered petals, leaves, and personalized wording in the center. The gallery shows the front, side, close-up, and reverse of a finished example.
decisions.proposed: Tell Mom she is your sunshine in a way she can put on display. This personalized sunflower sign turns a familiar sentiment into a Mother’s Day keepsake with wording chosen for her.

decisions.original: A wooden holder designed to present a gift card alongside an engraved Valentine message. Several photographed wording and decorative examples show the keepsake front and its gift-card slot; current choices are on Etsy.
decisions.proposed: Make a gift card feel more personal this Valentine’s Day. This wooden holder gives your card a place beside an engraved message, so the presentation becomes part of the gift. Check Etsy for current wording choices.

decisions.original: A vase-shaped wooden display with layered red roses and a message on the front. The gallery includes ‘Love Conquers All’ and personalized examples; check the Etsy listing for the wording offered now.
decisions.proposed: Say something meaningful with roses and words chosen for the person receiving them. This wooden rose vase display suits Valentine’s Day, an anniversary, or a just-because gift; check Etsy for the wording choices currently offered.
decisions.customText: Give someone special roses that will never wilt! This handcrafted wooden rose vase is a beautiful way to celebrate love, whether it's Valentine's Day, an anniversary, or simply a reminder of how much someone means to you. Add a personal message to make it a keepsake they'll treasure for years to come.
decisions.polishedText: Give someone special roses that will never wilt! This handcrafted wooden rose vase is a beautiful way to celebrate love, whether it’s Valentine’s Day, an anniversary, or simply a reminder of how much someone means to you. Add a personal message to make it a keepsake they’ll treasure for years to come.

decisions.original: A smiling sun with radiating yellow rays frames a personalized message for a family member. The front, side, and reverse photographs show the layered shape and example wording.
decisions.proposed: For the grandma, mom, or aunt who brightens your days, a personalized sunshine sign says it with a smile. Give it for Mother’s Day, a birthday, or simply to remind her how much she means to you.

decisions.original: A cedar plaque engraved to mark the time shared in a relationship, with example anniversary numbers shown in the gallery. Close views let you read the layout and see the wood grain; ask about the details for your own milestone.
decisions.proposed: An anniversary is more than a number. This engraved cedar plaque gives a shared milestone a place in the home and makes a personal gift for the person who has lived every day of it with you.

decisions.original: An acacia cutting board engraved with a family name and established date in the photographed example. The gallery shows the board both flat and in a kitchen setting, making the engraving and overall shape easy to examine.
decisions.proposed: A family name can turn a useful kitchen piece into a gift with a story. This custom-engraved acacia cutting board is well suited to weddings, housewarmings, and anniversaries. Confirm the name and date choices currently offered on Etsy.

decisions.original: A cherry wood plaque with engraved scripture and decorative borders, shown with Psalm 91 in the photographed example. The gallery includes close views of the engraving and the maker-marked reverse; inquire about current customization details.
decisions.proposed: Choose a scripture or Bible passage that speaks to the person receiving this cherry wood plaque. You can supply the passage you would like engraved; Psalm 91 is simply the example shown. Confirm text length and layout details before ordering.

decisions.original: A first-Christmas ornament with baby-footprint shapes, a name, and a year in the photographed example. Gallery close-ups and side views show the layered details and hanging shape.
decisions.proposed: Mark a baby’s first Christmas with a keepsake for the family tree. This ornament can carry a name and year, giving parents or grandparents a small reminder of a very big holiday.

decisions.original: A personalized Christmas keepsake displaying a baby’s name and birth information on a plaque with a stand. The photos show the lettered layout, stand, side profile, and reverse so families can see the complete display.
decisions.proposed: A first Christmas deserves its own place among the family keepsakes. This standing plaque brings a baby’s name and birth details together in a display that can come out again each holiday season. Confirm which details can be personalized before ordering.

decisions.original: A round Christmas sign with snowflakes, trees, ‘Merry Christmas’ lettering, and a red truck carrying a tree. Styled and close views show its layered colors, with the reverse also pictured.
decisions.proposed: The red truck carrying a tree makes this sign feel like Christmas is on its way. Bring it into a family room or holiday display for a familiar, cheerful seasonal scene.
decisions.customText: Bring a little old-fashioned Christmas charm into your home! Featuring a classic red pickup truck hauling home the Christmas tree, this handcrafted wooden sign captures the warmth and nostalgia of the holiday season. A festive addition to your Christmas decorations and a wonderful way to welcome the most wonderful time of the year.
decisions.polishedText: Bring a little old-fashioned Christmas charm into your home! Featuring a classic red pickup truck hauling home the Christmas tree, this handcrafted wooden sign captures the warmth and nostalgia of the holiday season. It’s a festive addition to your Christmas decorations and a wonderful way to welcome the most wonderful time of the year.

decisions.original: Santa stands beside a decorated Christmas tree beneath ‘Merry Christmas’ lettering and snowflakes. The gallery shows the round sign in a holiday setting, from the side, in detail, and from the back.
decisions.proposed: Give your Christmas decorating a little storybook cheer. This Santa-and-tree sign makes a welcoming piece for a family space where the holiday excitement is already building.
decisions.customText: Bring the magic of Christmas into your home! This handcrafted Santa & Tree Christmas Sign captures the joy and excitement of the holiday season. Perfect for adding a festive touch to your Christmas decorations, welcoming family and friends, or giving as a thoughtful gift to someone who loves Christmas.
decisions.polishedText: Bring the magic of Christmas into your home! This handcrafted Santa & Tree Christmas Sign captures the joy and excitement of the holiday season. It’s perfect for adding a festive touch to your Christmas decorations, welcoming family and friends, or giving as a thoughtful gift to someone who loves Christmas.

decisions.original: A round red and white sign styled like Santa’s suit, with ‘Santa Stop Here’ beneath the belt. Front, angled, and reverse photos show the raised festive details.
decisions.proposed: Make Santa feel expected. The “Santa Stop Here” sign is a playful addition to Christmas decorating, especially for a home with little ones watching for his arrival.

decisions.original: A winter cabin scene sits beneath ‘Merry Christmas’ lettering, with evergreens, snowflakes, and a sleigh silhouette. The photos show both the full round composition and its layered side profile.
decisions.proposed: For anyone who loves a quiet winter scene, this cabin sign brings that feeling into Christmas decorating. It makes a welcoming addition to a cozy room or a gift for someone who looks forward to the season all year.

decisions.original: Large ‘JOY’ lettering fills a round sign ringed with greenery and a red bow. Styled, front, side, and reverse views show the layered Christmas wreath design.
decisions.proposed: Put a simple note of joy into your Christmas decorating. This wooden wreath sign gives the familiar word a prominent place in a holiday display or a gift for someone who loves traditional seasonal pieces.
decisions.customText: Spread a little Christmas joy! This handcrafted wooden wreath sign brings together classic holiday greenery, a festive red bow, and a cheerful message that captures the spirit of the season. A beautiful way to welcome family and friends, brighten your Christmas decorations, or give someone a little extra joy this holiday season.
decisions.polishedText: Spread a little Christmas joy! This handcrafted wooden wreath sign brings together classic holiday greenery, a festive red bow, and a cheerful message that captures the spirit of the season. It’s a beautiful way to welcome family and friends, brighten your Christmas decorations, or give someone a little extra joy this holiday season.

decisions.original: A gingerbread house sits beneath a large ‘Welcome’ greeting, surrounded by candy-cane and scroll details. The styled and close photographs show how the round wooden sign looks over a holiday mantel and from the side.
decisions.proposed: Welcome guests with all the charm of a gingerbread house, minus the baking. This Christmas sign brings a playful holiday greeting to a family room or entryway.

decisions.original: A gingerbread figure peeks over a red mug reading ‘Merry Christmas,’ with a ribbon for hanging. The gallery includes front, side, close, and reverse views of this small holiday ornament.
decisions.proposed: Give the tree a little gingerbread cheer. This wooden mug ornament makes a sweet addition to a family’s Christmas collection or a small gift for someone who loves holiday treats.

decisions.original: A collection of round wooden ornaments combines cross designs with short faith-themed words and scripture. The gallery shows several distinct front designs and the reverse; browse the Etsy listing for current choices.
decisions.proposed: Make room for a quiet expression of faith on the Christmas tree. These wooden cross ornaments pair short scripture or faith-themed words with a design that can be given as a meaningful holiday gift. See Etsy for the versions currently offered.
decisions.customText: Celebrate the true meaning of Christmas with these handcrafted wooden cross ornaments. Featuring scripture and faith-inspired messages, they bring a meaningful reminder of the season to your Christmas tree. A thoughtful gift for family, friends, or anyone who wants to keep faith at the heart of their holiday celebrations.
decisions.polishedText: Celebrate the true meaning of Christmas with these handcrafted wooden cross ornaments. decisions.original: A snowflake-framed wooden ornament carries a name in its center, with a hanging ribbon shown in the photos. A group photograph shows multiple personalized examples alongside closer views of one ornament.
decisions.proposed: A name makes a Christmas ornament feel like it belongs to one particular person. This personalized snowflake can become part of a family tradition or a small gift for someone you want to remember each holiday season.
decisions.customText: Make their Christmas tree a little more special with a personalized wooden snowflake ornament! Featuring the name of someone you love, this handcrafted keepsake adds a personal touch to your holiday decorations. Perfect for children, grandchildren, family members, or friends, it's a thoughtful gift they'll look forward to hanging on the tree year after year.
decisions.polishedText: Make their Christmas tree a little more special with a personalized wooden snowflake ornament! Featuring the name of someone you love, this handcrafted keepsake adds a personal touch to your holiday decorations. It’s perfect for children, grandchildren, family members, or friends—a thoughtful gift they’ll look forward to hanging on the tree year after year.

decisions.original: A painted Santa-face ornament with name and year examples shown in the gallery. The close views highlight the hat, beard, and face, while the group photo illustrates different finished pieces.
decisions.proposed: A Santa ornament with a name and year makes a fun annual keepsake. This hand-painted piece can brighten a holiday display or become a personal stocking stuffer; check Etsy for current options.
decisions.customText: Make Santa part of your family's Christmas traditions! This hand-painted wooden Santa ornament adds a personal touch to your holiday tree with a name and year to remember. Whether you're celebrating a child's first Christmas, adding to your family's ornament collection, or giving someone a special holiday gift, it's a keepsake you'll enjoy bringing out year after year.
decisions.polishedText: Make Santa part of your family’s Christmas traditions! This hand-painted wooden Santa ornament adds a personal touch to your holiday tree with a name and year to remember. decisions.original: A layered round ornament marks a year above a winter cabin and evergreen scene. Two photographed examples show different year lettering; verify the year choices on Etsy before ordering.
decisions.proposed: Remember a year that mattered with a place for it on the Christmas tree. This layered ornament pairs the year with a winter cabin scene; check Etsy for the years currently offered.
decisions.customText: Some years deserve to be remembered! Celebrate a special year with this handcrafted wooden Christmas ornament featuring a charming winter cabin scene. Whether it marks a memorable Christmas, a family milestone, or another special occasion, it's a keepsake that brings back treasured memories each time you decorate the tree.
decisions.polishedText: Some years deserve to be remembered! Celebrate a special year with this handcrafted wooden Christmas ornament featuring a charming winter cabin scene. decisions.original: An engraved round ornament depicts a house above the ‘Daddy’s Home’ message, with year and small colored accents in the photographed example. Front, side, and reverse photographs show the complete piece.
decisions.proposed: For someone who enjoys political keepsakes with a sense of humor, this “Daddy’s Home” ornament makes a conversation piece on the tree. Check the Etsy listing for the exact year and design currently offered.

decisions.original: A round ornament with bold ‘Trump 2024’ lettering, red stripes, and star details. The gallery shows the layered front, side profile, and plain wooden reverse.
decisions.proposed: For a Trump supporter who collects election memorabilia, this engraved wooden ornament offers a way to mark the 2024 campaign at Christmas. It makes a distinctive gift for someone whose holiday collection reflects that moment.

decisions.original: A small laser-cut wooden box with tree silhouettes on its sides and an open top, shown holding pencils in one photo. Additional photos show the corner joinery, interior, sides, and bottom.
decisions.proposed: Give pens, small supplies, or keepsakes a place of their own. This laser-cut wooden box brings tree motifs to a desk or shelf and makes a useful small gift for someone who appreciates handmade details.
decisions.customText: A little organization with a touch of nature! This handcrafted wooden box features decorative tree designs that add rustic charm to any desk, shelf, or workspace. Perfect for keeping pens, small accessories, or treasured keepsakes neatly together, it's both a practical organizer and a thoughtful gift for someone who appreciates handmade craftsmanship.
decisions.polishedText: A little organization with a touch of nature! This handcrafted wooden box features decorative tree designs that add rustic charm to any desk, shelf, or workspace. It’s perfect for keeping pens, small accessories, or treasured keepsakes neatly together, making it both a practical organizer and a thoughtful gift for someone who appreciates handmade craftsmanship.

decisions.original: A heart-shaped memorial ornament framed by angel wings, with ‘Always on my Mind Forever in my Heart’ and an ‘In Loving Memory’ area. The gallery shows a finished example, close-ups, its reverse, and color mockups; ask about current personalization and color choices.
decisions.proposed: Keep a loved one’s memory close during the holidays. This angel-wings ornament offers a gentle place for a remembrance message and can become part of an annual Christmas tradition. Confirm current personalization and color choices on Etsy.
decisions.customText: Some people may no longer be with us, but they'll always have a special place in our hearts. This handcrafted angel wings memorial ornament is a beautiful way to honor someone you love during the holiday season. Personalized with their name and birth and passing dates, it creates a lasting tribute you can hang on your Christmas tree year after year, keeping their memory close during a time when they're especially missed.
decisions.polishedText: Some people may no longer be with us, but they’ll always have a special place in our hearts. Personalized with their name and birth and passing dates, it creates a lasting tribute you can hang on your Christmas tree year after year, keeping their memory close during a time when they’re especially missed.

decisions.original: A smiling reindeer with antlers and a red nose stands on a small base, with a name across its body in the photographed examples. The gallery shows several names, group arrangements, and side and reverse views.
decisions.proposed: Put a familiar name on a very cheerful reindeer. This painted wooden ornament makes a playful gift for a child or a personal addition to a family holiday display; check Etsy for current name choices.
decisions.customText: Make Christmas a little more magical with a personalized wooden reindeer! This cheerful, hand-painted decoration features the name of your choice, making it a special addition to your holiday decor. Perfect for displaying on a mantel, shelf, or tabletop, it also makes a thoughtful Christmas gift for children, grandchildren, or anyone who loves the holiday season.
decisions.polishedText: Make Christmas a little more magical with a personalized wooden reindeer! This cheerful, hand-painted decoration features the name of your choice, making it a special addition to your holiday decor. Perfect for displaying on a mantel, shelf, or tabletop, it also makes a thoughtful Christmas gift for children, grandchildren, or anyone who loves the holiday season.

decisions.original: A layered black-and-yellow sci-fi wordmark sign for a themed room or fan display. Gallery images show it staged, face-on, from the side, and from the reverse.
decisions.proposed: Turn a fan room into a little tribute to a favorite space saga. This layered wood sign adds a bold focal point for someone who likes their sci-fi collectibles out where they can be enjoyed.

decisions.original: A dark helmet silhouette forms the outline of this black-and-light wood sci-fi wall art. The staged, front, side, and reverse photos show the contrasting facial details and shape.
decisions.proposed: For the fan who keeps one foot on the dark side, this helmet wall art brings a familiar sci-fi mood to a media room or game space. It gives a favorite villain a place beyond the screen.

decisions.original: A blue-and-white astromech droid takes shape in this layered wall piece, with geometric body panels and a domed head. The gallery shows it in a themed display, close from the front, from the side, and on the reverse.
decisions.proposed: Give your favorite little droid a place in the room. This layered astromech wall art adds character to a game space, themed bedroom, or display of sci-fi favorites.

decisions.original: A black-and-white galactic soldier helmet becomes a graphic wooden wall sign. Front, side, staged, and reverse views show its bold visor and layered outline.
decisions.proposed: A sci-fi collection could use an unmistakable helmet at its center. This layered galactic soldier sign brings a bold fan favorite to a wall without needing a whole galaxy of space.

decisions.original: A blue helmet with red and yellow accents gives this bounty-hunter-inspired wall art its recognizable color blocking. The gallery includes a staged scene, flat front, side, and reverse views.
decisions.proposed: A playful nod to the galaxy’s most determined bounty hunters, this helmet wall art makes a striking piece for a fan’s room or collection. Pair it with other sci-fi favorites or let it have the wall to itself.

decisions.original: A pumpkin, autumn leaves, and a steaming coffee mug surround the ‘Hello Fall’ message on this round sign. The gallery shows the colorful front, layered edge, and wooden reverse.
decisions.proposed: If fall mornings mean hot coffee and crisp air to you, this “Hello Fall” sign fits right in. Bring it into a kitchen or seasonal display to welcome the coziest part of the year.

decisions.original: A bright pumpkin and colorful leaves sit beneath ‘Hello Fall’ lettering on a round wooden sign. Styled, front, angled, and reverse views show the raised autumn design.
decisions.proposed: Welcome pumpkin season with a sign that feels cheerful rather than spooky. This “Hello Fall” piece makes an easy starting point for decorating an entryway or family room for autumn.

decisions.original: A plaid pumpkin fills the center of this round autumn sign, with seasonal words around its edge. The gallery shows the full lettering and the sign’s side and reverse.
decisions.proposed: For the person who waits all year for cider, sweaters, and falling leaves, this plaid pumpkin sign says fall has arrived. Give it a place with your autumn decor or gift it to a fellow fall enthusiast.

decisions.original: A truck carrying pumpkins sits beneath ‘Welcome Fall’ lettering on a round sign. Front, angled, styled, and reverse photos show the layered farmhouse-style scene.
decisions.proposed: Make autumn decorating feel like a trip to the pumpkin patch. The “Welcome Fall” truck sign brings a warm seasonal greeting to a room or entryway.

decisions.original: A white haunted house, bats, and a small moon sit inside the ‘Home Sweet Haunted Home’ message on a dark round sign. The gallery shows the sign staged, front-on, from the side, and from the back.
decisions.proposed: Your Halloween decorating can have a little haunted-house humor without losing its homey feel. This “Home Sweet Haunted Home” sign is ready to join a playful spooky-season display.

decisions.original: A white ghost and bats frame the ‘Trick or Treat’ lettering on this dark round Halloween sign. Styled, front, side, and reverse photos show the contrast and layered details.
decisions.proposed: Set a playful mood for Halloween before the trick-or-treaters arrive. This ghost sign brings a familiar holiday greeting to an indoor entryway or party display.

decisions.original: A spider and web divide the ‘Welcome / Enter If You Dare’ wording on this round Halloween sign, with small bats around the border. Front, angled, staged, and reverse photos show its black-and-white design.
decisions.proposed: Give the entryway a theatrical Halloween warning. “Enter If You Dare” makes this spider-and-bat sign a fun choice for a spooky party or seasonal display.

decisions.original: A haunted house and bats appear over a ‘Welcome / Enter at Your Own Risk’ greeting. The dark round sign is photographed in a Halloween setting and from front, side, and reverse angles.
decisions.proposed: Guests have been warned—and welcomed. This haunted-house sign adds a mischievous “Enter at Your Own Risk” message to Halloween decorating.

decisions.original: An oval ‘Salem Broom Co.’ sign uses a broom, pointed hat, and ‘Fine Quality Brooms’ wording to suggest a playful witch’s shop. The gallery shows the layered front, side, styled view, and reverse.
decisions.proposed: Imagine a little broom shop in Salem that only opens in October. This “Salem Broom Co.” sign brings that playful witchy story to a Halloween display or a gift for someone who loves the season.

decisions.original: A round dark sign places a spider and web above a large ‘Welcome’ greeting. The gallery shows it hanging against a light wall, front-on, from the side, and from the back.
decisions.proposed: For Halloween decorating that leans spooky rather than silly, this spider-web welcome sign sets the tone. It makes a dramatic greeting for an indoor entryway or themed gathering.

decisions.original: Four colorful Adirondack chairs sit beneath ‘Relax’ and above ‘Sit & Unwind’ on this round coastal sign. The gallery shows the wall display, front, side, and reverse.
decisions.proposed: Bring that “sit and unwind” feeling into a room you use every day. This Adirondack chair sign suits a coastal-inspired space or a gift for someone who is happiest near the water.

decisions.original: A smiling tooth holds two toothbrushes beneath a blue ‘Welcome’ banner in this playful dental-office sign. The gallery includes a wall setting, close front and side views, and the reverse.
decisions.proposed: Make patients feel welcome before they take a seat. This smiling-tooth sign gives a dental office a friendly touch that children and adults can enjoy.

decisions.original: Kennedy Laser Works is a small Budd Lake maker business where thoughtful design and laser precision meet patient, hands-on finishing.
decisions.proposed:
I'm the owner and craftsman behind Kennedy Laser Works. I create custom laser-engraved signs, personalized gifts, plaques, and one-of-a-kind pieces using a combination of laser technology and traditional woodworking techniques.

From designing and engraving to sanding, painting, and finishing, I take pride in making each piece something you'll be proud to give or display.

decisions.original: Kevin creates made-to-order pieces at Kennedy Laser Works in Budd Lake, New Jersey. From design to the final finish, every piece is created with attention to detail using a blend of laser precision and hand craftsmanship.
decisions.proposed:
I create custom, made-to-order pieces at Kennedy Laser Works, combining laser engraving with traditional woodworking techniques. From the initial design to the final finish, I personally handle each project with attention to detail.

Whether you have a finished design, a rough idea, or just an occasion in mind, I'll work with you to create something special.

My goal is simple: to create something personal, meaningful, and made just for you.
